summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The LHA Market State Tactical Beta ETF (MSTB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that aims to outperform the large-cap US equity market by holding long exposure to the S&P 500 combined with a dynamic risk overlay. The risk overlay can go long or short equity and volatility through the use of derivatives. MSTB was launched on Sep 30, 2020 and is issued by Little Harbor Advisors.
